description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Catalog/NewGetListingStatus. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns recent catalog publication jobs and their listing results. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use to inspect recorded publication status or errors, not to discover supplier products. Input: Header channel identifies the selected store. No body. Output: Returns job status and listing status/error data with EnumValues. Url identifies new publications even before ProductSourceId resolution; ProductSourceId remains available for legacy clients. ListingStatus.Status is a bitmask and can combine flags. Search terms: catalog newgetlistingstatus. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_catalog_newgetlistingstatus
